claim_boundary: Original JAI minimum informed by adopted sources; not certification or an exhaustive official deliverable list.

S1.title: SABSA Matrices 2018 Release Notes
S1.adopted_scope: Updated matrix terminology and architecture versus management activity distinction.

S2.title: Enterprise Security Architecture white paper
S2.adopted_scope: Introductory business attributes, architecture, lifecycle and assurance principles.

contextual.what.question: what
contextual.what.purpose: Business assets and information within the architecture boundary.

contextual.why.question: why
contextual.why.purpose: Business drivers, opportunities, constraints, risk limits and measurable required qualities.

contextual.how.question: how
contextual.how.purpose: Business activities that achieve the requested outcomes.

contextual.who.question: who
contextual.who.purpose: Stakeholders, accountable owners and decision authority.

contextual.where.question: where
contextual.where.purpose: Operating environments, jurisdictions and business locations.

contextual.when.question: when
contextual.when.purpose: Planning horizons, important events, critical periods and tolerances.

conceptual.what.question: what
conceptual.what.purpose: Business-justified concepts, objectives and protection principles.

conceptual.why.question: why
conceptual.why.purpose: Required business attributes, strategy and risk rationale.

conceptual.how.question: how
conceptual.how.purpose: Policy concepts and approaches to achieving business objectives.

conceptual.who.question: who
conceptual.who.purpose: Governance, responsibilities and accountable concept owners.

conceptual.where.question: where
conceptual.where.purpose: Conceptual domains, trust boundaries and relationships between domains.

conceptual.when.question: when
conceptual.when.purpose: Lifecycle principles and significant timing constraints.

logical.what.question: what
logical.what.purpose: Information structures, control requirements and their meanings.

logical.how.question: how
logical.how.purpose: Logical functions, services and their interactions.

logical.who.question: who
logical.who.purpose: Actors, authorization responsibilities and privilege boundaries.

logical.where.question: where
logical.where.purpose: Logical placement, trust and information flows.

logical.when.question: when
logical.when.purpose: Event ordering, schedules and timing constraints.

physical.what.question: what
physical.what.purpose: Chosen mechanisms and concrete information or resource arrangements.

physical.why.question: why
physical.why.purpose: Alternatives, selection rationale and satisfied requirements.

physical.how.question: how
physical.how.purpose: Concrete processes, technology and integration mechanisms.

physical.who.question: who
physical.who.purpose: Operating responsibilities and physical or organizational endpoints.

physical.where.question: where
physical.where.purpose: Topology, deployment locations and operating environments.

physical.when.question: when
physical.when.purpose: Implementation sequencing, timing mechanisms and service windows.

component.what.question: what
component.what.purpose: Detailed components, interfaces and configuration specifications.

component.why.question: why
component.why.purpose: Satisfied requirements and verifiable implementation behavior.

component.how.question: how
component.how.purpose: Build, configuration and detailed realization procedures.

management.what.question: what
management.what.purpose: Managed assets, required attributes and service objectives.

management.why.question: why
management.why.purpose: Governance, assurance, risk and improvement objectives.

management.how.question: how
management.how.purpose: Operation, monitoring, support, incident, change, maintenance and resilience practices.

management.who.question: who
management.who.purpose: Responsible owners, support responsibilities and escalation paths.

management.where.question: where
management.where.purpose: Operating locations and control coverage across all other layers.

management.when.question: when
management.when.purpose: Triggers, windows, measurement periods, reviews and feedback cadence.

conceptual.attributes.purpose: Tailored business attributes with explicit targets, measurement and accountability.

management.activity.purpose: A governed activity definition; this does not demonstrate its execution.

management.measure.purpose: A proposed or established measurement definition, distinct from observed results.

management.observation.purpose: An actual result against an exact subject and measure, with supporting evidence.

trace_direction: from dependent unit to its justifying business basis
